name: Palazuelos de Eresma (Spain)
description: The upper two thirds divided vertically dark teal blue and pale orange-yellow, the lower third of five stripes alternating teal blue and white.
history: Municipal flag of Palazuelos de Eresma; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: upper part divided dark blue at the hoist and pale orange at the fly
five narrow stripes of teal blue and white in the lower third
